API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIEmergency Access ManagementCreates an emergency access user for the specified customer.
Creates an emergency access user for the specified customer.
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/emergencyAccess/user

Creates an emergency access user for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
activateNow
boolean

Indicates if the emergency access user is activated upon

Default value: true
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.
